sources.title: Qwen3-0.6B: Compact Dense Transformer LLM
sources.snippet: Qwen3-0.6B is a dense transformer model with 600M parameters, designed to deliver efficient chain-of-thought reasoning and robust multilingual support. It employs 28 decoder blocks with grouped query attention, RoPE positional encoding, and a multi-stage pretraining pipeline over 36 trillion tokens. The Qwen3‑0.6B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual language model with 0.6 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities.
